verdict.rationale: Official docs explicitly describe an MCP server enabling connection from Claude, Cursor, Windsurf, or any MCP client, and a probe confirms the MCP-server doc page exists (browser-use-docs-12, browser-use-probe-3). However, a community/hands-on report states the product 'doesn't support MCP integration' when trying to use it with Cursor (browser-use-comm-4), directly contradicting the documented capability. missing for 10: independent corroboration that the MCP server works end-to-end, resolution of the conflicting community report.
